pages.title: Compendium Account
pages.text: The Thunderhorn Rock Badger makes its home among rugged mountains and rocky slopes. Bearing a horn infused with thunderous energy, it is stubborn and fiercely territorial. It is often encountered in highlands where harsh winds sweep across exposed stone.

pages.title: Where to Find
pages.text: Found in windswept regions, stony, jagged, and frozen peaks, meadows, groves, and dripstone caves, on solid ground.
